plan.title: Heart 2x2 genotype x drug interaction DE + pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question — does the drug act differently in KO vs WT heart tissue — is a genotype x treatment interaction question on a 2x2 factorial design (WT/KO x vehicle/drug, n=4/cell, 16 samples, 12000 genes, raw Salmon counts). The interaction coefficient (genotype:treatment) is the direct test of whether the drug effect differs by genotype; the two simple effects (drug vs vehicle within WT, and within KO) contextualize it. Per the grounded procedure: QC sample structure first (vst-blind PCA/distances) to confirm the four groups separate and no sample is mislabeled/outlier before fitting; minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples, the smallest cell size); PyDESeq2 with design ~ genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment, explicit reference levels (WT, vehicle); Wald tests for the interaction term and each simple effect; ashr shrinkage (contrasts, not single coefficients); BH-FDR with independent filtering at alpha 0.05, per contrast, with a p-value histogram diagnostic. Enrichment is run as over-representation analysis (ORA) with an explicit tested-gene universe per contrast — the interaction/no-flag decision from the knowledge check requires ORA rather than preranked GSEA in this exact situation, so the plan uses the significant gene list per contrast (interaction contrast, and each simple effect) against MSigDB Hallmark and WikiPathways human, and flags per-contrast whether the significant list clears the ~50-gene threshold ORA needs to have power. All scripts are Python per user constraint (pydeseq2, gseapy, statsmodels), with DESeq2/ashr/fgsea R alternatives available in environment only as a documented fallback, not used.
